title: Explore a Tier 5 Bastion or equivalent
description:
The Night Lich and Void Blossom offer alternative Overworld milestones. A Bastion is a Tier 5 structure; a Nether Fortress is Tier 4.

Explore a Tier 5 Bastion or equivalent.
